nodes.label: Offline cognition — first slice
nodes.rationale: The slice is deliberately unwired from kernel, executor and admission, and imports only stdlib and itself, so that passing tests claim point-in-time mechanical correctness on synthetic fixtures and nothing about edge or profitability.

nodes.label: Attention and competing-hypothesis loop
nodes.rationale: Attention is nondirectional and competing hypotheses stay separate with contradicting evidence kept rather than netted, unlike REQUIREMENTS.md's vote-blending design; probability stays null until a calibration exists.
